//: shared/content.ts, the four ladders under shared/curricula/ and
shared/tool-strings.ts, compiled to the six files the browser
fetches: /content.js, /money/curriculum.js,
/deutsch/curriculum.js, /quran/curriculum.js,
/english/curriculum.js and /tools/stock.i18n.js.
scripts/build-modules.ts runs this and rebases the four
specifiers content.ts uses to reach a ladder, because the
output puts them one directory apart in the other direction.
It is a second config rather than a flag on
shared/tsconfig.json because that one is the answer to 'does
shared/ typecheck', and noEmit is what keeps it an answer
rather than an artefact.
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions is what pairs with
allowImportingTsExtensions here. The imports name a real
filename, ./curricula/money.ts, because node reads these files
with no build step; the browser needs a .js, and this is the
flag that turns one into the other on the way out.
removeComments stays off: this repository's comments carry the
constraints, and a served module a reader opens in a browser is
the one place they are read without the repository to hand.
outDir is overridden by the generator on every run. It names a
scratch directory rather than nothing so that running this by
hand cannot drop a content.js beside its own source, which is
the one file in shared/ that would then be read instead of it.
